core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fouzia corresponds to the Arabic form فوزية (Arabic root ف و ز (f-w-z); فوزية (Fawziyya)). Its core sense is victorious, triumphant. Fouzia is a transliteration of Arabic فوزية (Fawziyya), the feminine of فوزي (Fawzī), from the root ف و ز (f-w-z) 'to triumph, succeed'. It means 'victorious, triumphant, successful'. The source gloss 'fragrant blossom' is wrong and has been replaced.
